request.previewEndpoint: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/explorers/{explorerId}/authoring/v2/preview, receipt-bound if the proposal response preview does not match

gates.when: selectedStage.capabilities[FILTER].supported
gates.effect: Otherwise show the server reason and emit no candidate.

gates.when: condition column id exists in selected predecessor stage
gates.effect: Otherwise the candidate is incomplete or a saved condition is shown as unsupported.

dimensions.description: The condition column comes from the stage immediately before the filter step.
Logical types map string/uuid→STRING, code→CODE, boolean→BOOLEAN, integer→INTEGER, decimal/number→DECIMAL, date→DATE, and date_time/datetime→DATE_TIME; other types have no value editor.
EXISTS/MISSING are always offered; EQUALS/NOT_EQUALS/IN require a mapped value kind; CONTAINS_TEXT requires STRING; comparisons require INTEGER, DECIMAL, DATE, or DATE_TIME.

conditional.when: operator is EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, CONTAINS_TEXT, GT, GTE, LT, or LTE

dimensions.description: IN has an Add another value control with no explicit UI maximum. INTEGER requires a JavaScript safe integer; DECIMAL must be finite; DATE must match YYYY-MM-DD; DATE_TIME must parse as a valid instant.

constraints.statement: The UI serializes typed FILTER values, retains predecessor-stage columns, and appends or replaces one FILTER step.
The shared proposal panel offers Apply only for a READY proposal whose proposal id, preview receipt/output, snapshot token, draft version, and draft digest match the current table.

invariants.statement: Rows must match every saved row condition.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Proposal preview runs automatically; an explicit receipt-bound /preview request fills a missing or mismatched embedded preview.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Separate Apply change action sends APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_PROPOSAL after current-identity validation.

model_binding.statement: Typed control values become a FILTER operation passed to the backend proposal compiler; capability/proposal responses remain authoritative.

gates.when: RELATED_ELIGIBILITY is supported and selectedStage.relatedExpandAnchors is non-empty
gates.effect: Related records mode remains visible but its button is disabled when the gate is false.

gates.when: A returned route choice must match the requested anchor column and target resource type.
gates.effect: Only the selected exact route is serialized.

dimensions.description: The input declares min=1 and step=1; no upper bound is declared in the UI.
EQUALS is available only for string/code contributor fields; repeated fields match when any item matches.

constraints.statement: Related match predicates are EXISTS, ABSENT, or COUNT_AT_LEAST; the minimum count field has min=1/step=1 and no UI maximum.

invariants.statement: This operation filters current rows; it does not add columns or multiply rows.
For COUNT_AT_LEAST, a matching related record is counted once per current row even if multiple starting records link to it.

independent_preview_apply.preview: The common construction proposal panel previews candidate rows against a proposal receipt.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Separate Apply change action sends APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_PROPOSAL.

model_binding.statement: Selected route, anchor, match, and contributor predicate become one RELATED_ELIGIBILITY operation; unsupported capability disables the related-mode affordance.

gates.when: table has at least one construction step and append-stage DERIVE capability is supported
gates.effect: Calculate appears in More actions only when true.

gates.when: COLUMN operands reference integer/decimal/number columns returned for the selected stage
gates.effect: Other stage columns are not selectable as operands.

dynamicProvider.property: numeric columns for COLUMN; typed literal editor for LITERAL
numeric columns for COLUMN; typed literal editor for LITERAL

dimensions.description: Parser accepts exactly two numeric operands and one +, -, *, or / operator; column names match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; literals support decimal/exponent syntax, finite values, and safe integers for integer notation. No formula max length is declared.
Must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, be unique case-sensitively against stage names, and has no declared maximum length.

constraints.statement: Formula view does not support functions, nested expressions, parentheses, or conditionals.
A derive step retains predecessor columns and adds one output column; replacing a saved step preserves its output column id.

invariants.statement: Operands are numeric stage columns or finite numeric literals; missing-input and division-by-zero policies are explicitly submitted.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Shared construction proposal panel previews the READY receipt, with explicit /preview fallback if required.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Separate Apply change action sends APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_PROPOSAL.

model_binding.statement: Guided controls and the one-operation formula parser serialize to a DERIVE operation submitted through the construction proposal compiler.

entries.surface: Mounted legacy non-construction Builder table shape settings

operation.variant: derived numeric column attached to NONE, GROUPED_PIVOT, or UNPIVOT shape

request.resolutionEndpoint: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/explorers/{explorerId}/authoring/v2/table-shape-resolutions, kind DERIVED for each derived column

gates.when: table.document.construction is absent
gates.effect: Table shape settings are mounted only for a non-construction table.

gates.when: TableShapeCapabilities.derivedAvailability is supported
gates.effect: Otherwise Add derived column is disabled with the server reason.

gates.when: reshape mode is UNPIVOT and unpivotWithDerivedAvailability is supported
gates.effect: Otherwise Add is disabled and the refusal reason is shown.

dynamicProvider.response: TableShapeCapabilities.operands and prior derived columns; selected pivot output set when mode=GROUPED_PIVOT

dimensions.description: Each derived expression has exactly two operand slots, left and right.
Must be finite; integer representation must be a JavaScript safe integer. No numeric range bound is declared.

dynamicProvider.property: supported choices when selected operator requires it

dynamicProvider.response: User-added form rows constrained by supported choices

dimensions.description: No maximum derived-column count is declared by the UI.

constraints.statement: Derived references may point only to an earlier derived output; pivot-output operands require a selected grouped-pivot output; grouped pivot removes base-column operands.
Each derived output requires a supported binary operator, two complete operands, a supported missing-input policy, and complete unique output names.

invariants.statement: The user reviews a table-shape comparison before applying the proposal; Apply uses the proposal id only while its table/draft context is current.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Preview table shape opens a proposal comparison after server resolutions; this is a distinct legacy table-shape proposal flow.

model_binding.statement: UI operand intent is resolved into server choice/resolution references and submitted in a table-shape proposal; it does not create a construction DERIVE step.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Add columns source controls

operation.variant: local source scope selection for catalog browsing

request.selectionConstructor: BuilderWorkspace.addColumnsSourceControls updates local selectedAddSource scope; selection itself sends no write command
request.browseConstructor: ConceptCatalog.browseCurrentPage calls browseSemanticInventory with current snapshot, rowRoot, resourceType, query, cursor, and page limit
request.choiceEndpoint: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/explorers/{explorerId}/authoring/v2/construction-choices after selecting a catalog item

gates.when: source node is a row-root node, catalog-reachable related node, saved occurrence, or exact active related record in fields view
gates.effect: The set depends on current catalog graph, row root, selected occurrence, and active related-record stage.

gates.when: selected source kind is EXACT_RELATED
gates.effect: Selecting it switches the catalog to Other fields; switching to Coded values returns source selection to ROOT.

dimensions.description: No query length maximum is declared.

constraints.statement: Changing browse source changes catalog scope only; it does not itself add or mutate a table column.
Related source nodes are derived from graph connectivity to the row-root seeds; source node id distinguishes multiple routes of the same resource type.

invariants.statement: Catalog browse is bound to the current table, catalog snapshot, selected resource scope, and optional selected occurrence context.

independent_preview_apply.preview: None for changing browse source; later selected catalog choices have their own preview flows.
independent_preview_apply.apply: No apply action for source selection.

model_binding.statement: Source option changes the field/semantic browse context and subsequent choice search; the source choice is not itself persisted as a table operation.

gates.when: item has an exact-concept identity or a SYSTEM_VERSION_CATEGORY identity with a family id
gates.effect: Only catalog items with a complete selection identity are submitted.

gates.when: choice response contains a form with support=SUPPORTED
gates.effect: Only supported server-returned choices are selectable for submission.

constraints.statement: The catalog submits returned choice ids and selected supported forms; it does not infer a semantic form from the item's label.

invariants.statement: The proposal preview must return rows for the selected output before APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_CHOICE commands are sent.

independent_preview_apply.preview: The selected-choice proposal returns a preview before the command; this flow applies after the preview check without a separate proposal-panel Apply button.
independent_preview_apply.apply: APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_CHOICE command follows successful preview and current-draft identity checks.

model_binding.statement: Semantic identity, selected route, choice id, and supported form bind the catalog selection to a backend construction-choice proposal.

gates.when: candidate is populated and offered for the selected source/resource/route
gates.effect: Unpopulated candidates are removed from the displayed field catalog.

gates.when: sourceProjectionAvailability.available for the selected stage
gates.effect: Otherwise source fields show an unavailable notice and cannot be added through this path.

gates.when: choice response contains a form with support=SUPPORTED
gates.effect: Only returned supported choices can be added.

dimensions.description: The UI trims/normalizes display names; no maximum length is declared.

constraints.statement: The Add selected flow sends server-returned choice ids/forms and validates preview output identity before applying the construction-choice command.

invariants.statement: Only selected fields are added; source projection remains gated by the capability response for the current stage.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Selected-choice preview is generated before apply.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Apply is automatic after a matching preview; no separate Apply button is shown for this catalog operation.

model_binding.statement: The field candidate and a server-supported construction choice bind to a choice proposal; the response supplies the applied choice ids.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Add columns and saved related-step editors
path: Choose related source or an active related record

variants: RELATED_SOURCE scalar field from a routed related resource
RELATED_FIELD scalar field from an active related record

gates.when: RELATED_SOURCE capability supported, stage has rowIdentityColumn, editor is at current append stage, and returned source field is optional_one or required_one
gates.effect: Unsupported and repeated source fields are not submitted; related catalog choices are suppressed when capability is false.

gates.when: selected stage has activeRelatedRecord and returned choice source matches its target node/resource and is scalar optional_one/required_one
gates.effect: Otherwise the editor reports no exact related record or filters the choice out.

dynamicProvider.property: source node/resource equals selectedStage.activeRelatedRecord target; scalar cardinality

dimensions.description: Must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* and be unique case-insensitively within the selected stage; no maximum length is declared.

constraints.statement: Routed related source batching accepts only fields on the same exact route; its supported forms are ALL, COUNT, and PRESENCE; repeated source fields are rejected.
RELATED_FIELD outputs are nullable; missing exact related records produce empty values, and the saved editor preserves the selected output column id.

invariants.statement: The routed RELATED_SOURCE operation uses the selected row identity anchor and exact returned route; related field edits are bound to the active related record at that stage.

independent_preview_apply.preview: RELATED_SOURCE Add selected flow obtains a READY proposal preview; route coverage inspection is a separate preview path. RELATED_FIELD step editing uses the shared proposal panel.
independent_preview_apply.apply: RELATED_SOURCE Add selected immediately calls applyConstructionProposal after READY; it has no separate user Apply click. RELATED_FIELD saved-step edits use the shared proposal panel Apply action.

model_binding.statement: The two UI routes bind to different operation variants, RELATED_SOURCE and RELATED_FIELD, with response-bound route or active-record provenance.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Add columns workspace for a grouped row source
path: Values from each row's contributing records

operation.variant: rowValuePolicy on supported ALL construction choices

gates.when: final source stage reports ROW_VALUES supported
gates.effect: Only then show the policy control and pass rowValuePolicy into eligible ALL construction choices.

dimensions.description: ALL means keep all distinct values; ONE means require one distinct value.

constraints.statement: Missing values stay empty; ONE stops if contributing records disagree.

invariants.statement: The selected row-value policy is serialized only for ALL forms and only when the server capability is supported.

independent_preview_apply.preview: The choice proposal generates a row preview before apply.
independent_preview_apply.apply: APPLY_CONSTRUCTION_CHOICE follows a successful preview and matching output/draft identity.

model_binding.statement: The two-value UI policy binds to rowValuePolicy on the selected supported choice; it is not inferred from a label or backend enum alone.

path: Use as filter or Add as filter

operation.variant: configure a filter control for an output column

request.existingColumnConstructor: ColumnSelector configured column onChange → BuilderWorkspace.applyPresentationChanges → previewPresentationCommand emits UPDATE_COLUMN
request.newFieldConstructor: ColumnSelector available field onAdd → BuilderWorkspace.applyCommands emits ADD_COLUMN with initialPresentation=FILTER

gates.when: candidate.filterable or configured-column filterability is true
gates.effect: Unsupported candidate filter checkbox is visible but disabled; configured-column toggle remains enabled to remove an existing filter even if no longer filterable.

gates.when: output is a construction output
gates.effect: Filter control is visibly unavailable for the constructed output.

constraints.statement: The Builder toggle configures whether an output column is offered as a filter control; this surface does not author row predicate operators or filter values.
Configured filterability falls back to true when no configured capability object exists; candidate checkboxes use candidate.filterable directly.

invariants.statement: Constructed output rows display that filters are unavailable; their presentation column editor does not expose a filter toggle.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No independent proposal preview; presentation commands save directly and Builder refreshes its table preview.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Immediate UPDATE_COLUMN or ADD_COLUMN command through /commands.

model_binding.statement: Filter presentation state binds to authored column presentation metadata or initialPresentation on ADD_COLUMN; it is distinct from FILTER construction operations.
